testcase.system-out: Scenario: extrusion-15 Cut selects inward direction and supports history ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given the diameter-3 circle on the base top face ✔ When Extrude opens in Default direction and Cut is selected ✔ Then Direction changes to Flipped and the preview shows an opening ✔ When OK is clicked with Distance A 8 mm and zero taper ✔ Then Extrusion2 and the opening are retained in one solid body ✔ When Undo then Redo are invoked ✔ Then the opening disappears then returns
